name: Open items on hover
kurz: When the mouse is over an area on the map with a yellow or red marker, an overlay lists its open items, for example 2 rule violations, 10 cases without a rule and 1 deviating scenario. It disappears when the mouse leaves the area; until then the map looks the same.

wuensche.name: Open items on hover
wuensche.wortlaut: In the Navigator, I want a temporary overlay displaying the entries to appear when I hover the mouse over areas where rule violations are indicated by yellow or red markers. When the mouse leaves the area, the overlay should disappear.
